name: viglet-dumont-wordpress-admin
description: The plugin's admin screens, built with @wordpress/scripts into src/admin/build/.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build assets/admin/health.js assets/admin/mapping.js assets/admin/setup.js --output-path=src/admin/build && node bin/copy-sdk.mjs
scripts.start: wp-scripts start assets/admin/health.js assets/admin/mapping.js assets/admin/setup.js --output-path=src/admin/build && node bin/copy-sdk.mjs
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets/admin src/public bin src/admin/js/search-block-editor.js tests/e2e playwright.config.mjs
